newsitem.title: JAPAN: BOJ says policy aimed at strengthening recovery.
newsitem.headline: BOJ says policy aimed at strengthening recovery.

text.p: The Bank of Japan (BOJ) will continue to carry out its monetary policy of putting emphasis on strengthening the basis for economic recovery, a BOJ spokesman said on Wednesday.

The BOJ will conduct policy aimed at achieving economic growth without inflation and "for the time being, carry out monetary policy with an emphasis on strengthening the basis for economic recovery while carefully monitoring future developments," the spokesman told Reuters.
He said this was also explained to a Japanese labour group which earlier visited the bank and requested a rise in the official discount rate.

Earlier, an executive of the labour group, the Japanese Trade Union Confederation (Rengo), Japan's largest grouping of labour unions, told reporters that BOJ Deputy Governor Toshihiko Fukui said in their meeting that the BOJ is considering the right timing to raise the official discount rate but it does not want to make a hasty decision.
Fukui was also quoted as saying that the group's request was understandable.

The group said that to continue the current low interest rate policy would be harmful for the Japanese economy and that rates should be raised as early as possible to what it called a proper level. It did not specify what level it wanted to see.
